WITH aggregate_rows AS (
              SELECT
                bat AS batter,
                COUNT(DISTINCT p_match) AS matches,
                COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(p_match AS VARCHAR) || ':' || CAST(inns AS VARCHAR) || ':' || CAST(team_bat AS VARCHAR)) AS innings,
                SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(ballfaced AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls_faced,
                SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRY_CAST(wide AS INTEGER), 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(noball AS INTEGER), 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS legal_balls,
                SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(ballfaced AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sample_balls,
                SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(ballfaced AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN TRY_CAST(batruns AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) AS runs_scored,
                SUM(TRY_CAST(bowlruns AS INTEGER)) AS runs_conceded,
                SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(CAST(dismissal AS VARCHAR)) IN ('caught', 'bowled', 'leg before wicket', 'stumped', 'hit wicket', 'caught and bowled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets,
                SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(ballfaced AS INTEGER) = 1 AND LOWER(CAST(out AS VARCHAR)) = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissals,
                SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(ballfaced AS INTEGER) = 1 AND TRY_CAST(batruns AS INTEGER) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dot_balls,
                SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRY_CAST(wide AS INTEGER), 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(noball AS INTEGER), 0) = 0 AND TRY_CAST(bowlruns AS INTEGER) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bowler_dot_balls,
                SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(ballfaced AS INTEGER) = 1 AND TRY_CAST(batruns AS INTEGER) = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS four_count,
                SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(ballfaced AS INTEGER) = 1 AND TRY_CAST(batruns AS INTEGER) = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS six_count,
                SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(ballfaced AS INTEGER) = 1 AND TRY_CAST(batruns AS INTEGER) IN (4, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS boundary_balls,
                SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(ballfaced AS INTEGER) = 1 AND TRY_CAST(batruns AS INTEGER) IN (4, 6) THEN TRY_CAST(batruns AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END) AS boundary_runs,
                SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(ballfaced AS INTEGER) = 1 AND TRY_CAST(control AS DOUBLE) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS false_shots,
                SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(ballfaced AS INTEGER) = 1 AND TRY_CAST(control AS DOUBLE) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS controlled_balls,
                SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRY_CAST(wide AS INTEGER), 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(noball AS INTEGER), 0) = 0 AND length = 'YORKER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yorker_balls
              FROM analytics.deliveries_v1
              WHERE 1 = 1 AND bat = ? AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(bat AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL
              GROUP BY bat
            )
            SELECT
              batter,
              matches,
              innings,
              balls_faced,
              legal_balls,
              sample_balls AS balls,
              runs_scored,
              runs_conceded,
              wickets,
              dismissals,
              dot_balls,
              bowler_dot_balls,
              four_count,
              six_count,
              boundary_balls,
              boundary_runs,
              false_shots,
              yorker_balls,
              six_count AS six_count
            FROM aggregate_rows
            ORDER BY six_count DESC, sample_balls DESC, batter ASC
            LIMIT ?

                CASE WHEN CAST(daynight AS VARCHAR) = 'day match' THEN 'day match' WHEN CAST(daynight AS VARCHAR) = 'day/night match' THEN 'day/night match' WHEN CAST(daynight AS VARCHAR) = 'night match' THEN 'night match' ELSE NULL END AS split_value,
                p_match,
                inns,
                team_bat,
                CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(ballfaced AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS balls_faced,
                CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRY_CAST(wide AS INTEGER), 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(noball AS INTEGER), 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS legal_balls,
                CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(ballfaced AS INTEGER) = 1 THEN TRY_CAST(batruns AS INTEGER) ELSE 0 END AS runs_scored,
                TRY_CAST(bowlruns AS INTEGER) AS runs_conceded,
                CASE WHEN LOWER(CAST(dismissal AS VARCHAR)) IN ('caught', 'bowled', 'leg before wicket', 'stumped', 'hit wicket', 'caught and bowled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS wickets,
                CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(ballfaced AS INTEGER) = 1 AND LOWER(CAST(out AS VARCHAR)) = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS dismissals,
                CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(ballfaced AS INTEGER) = 1 AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(batruns AS INTEGER), 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS dot_balls,
                CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRY_CAST(wide AS INTEGER), 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(noball AS INTEGER), 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(bowlruns AS INTEGER), 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bowler_dot_balls,
                CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRY_CAST(wide AS INTEGER), 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(TRY_CAST(noball AS INTEGER), 0) = 0 AND TRY_CAST(batruns AS INTEGER) IN (4, 6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS boundary_balls
              FROM analytics.deliveries_v1
              WHERE 1 = 1 AND bowl = ?
                AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(bowl AS VARCHAR)), '') IS NOT NULL
            ),
            split_rows AS (
              SELECT
                entity,
                split_value,
                COUNT(DISTINCT p_match) AS matches,
                COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(p_match AS VARCHAR) || ':' || CAST(inns AS VARCHAR) || ':' || CAST(team_bat AS VARCHAR)) AS innings,
                SUM(balls_faced) AS balls_faced,
                SUM(legal_balls) AS legal_balls,
                SUM(runs_scored) AS runs_scored,
                SUM(runs_conceded) AS runs_conceded,
                SUM(wickets) AS wickets,
                SUM(dismissals) AS dismissals,
                SUM(dot_balls) AS dot_balls,
                SUM(bowler_dot_balls) AS bowler_dot_balls,
                SUM(boundary_balls) AS boundary_balls,
                SUM(legal_balls) AS sample_size,
                SUM(runs_conceded) / NULLIF(SUM(legal_balls) / 6.0, 0) AS metric_value
              FROM bucketed
              WHERE split_value IN ('day match', 'day/night match')
              GROUP BY entity, split_value
            ),
            pivoted AS (
              SELECT
                entity AS bowler,
                MAX(CASE WHEN split_value = 'day match' THEN metric_value END) AS day_match_value,
                MAX(CASE WHEN split_value = 'day/night match' THEN metric_value END) AS day_night_match_value,
                MAX(CASE WHEN split_value = 'day match' THEN sample_size END) AS day_match_sample,

              day_night_match_sample,

            FROM pivoted
            WHERE (day_match_value IS NOT NULL OR day_night_match_value IS NOT NULL)

            LIMIT ?
